title: SCAPI | B2C Commerce API
snippet:
The B2C Commerce API (SCAPI) is a set of RESTful APIs for building storefronts, merchant tools, and integrations on the B2C Commerce platform. It also goes by “Salesforce Commerce API” or just “Commerce API.” For B2C Commerce customers, the API is available at no extra cost.

In addition to securing access to the Shopper API, SLAS can also turn on third-party identity providers, single sign-on, and personalization in your application.

title: Develop Full Stack Commerce capabilities for your Salesforce practice
snippet:
To prove these Commerce capabilities, individuals in your practice must earn Salesforce certifications and Accredited Professional (AP) credentials, including:
- [2 B2C Commerce Architects](https://trailhead.salesforce.com/en/credentials/b2ccommercearchitect)
- [5 B2C Commerce Developers](https://trailhead.salesforce.com/en/credentials/b2ccommercedeveloper)
- [5 B2B Administrator AP ](https://partnerlearningcamp.salesforce.com/s/credentials-catalog?plc__recordId=RUJXuwt20q%2FICcqBNvX8YP8x2llKeVEQFb5fK25XOisT4TCO%2BYJfvkjED9WxfZOb)
